name: init_project
description:
Link this working directory to a CodeMySpec project.

Fetches project details from the server and creates/updates the local
database record with `local_path` set to the working directory.

project_id.description: UUID of the project to link (from list_projects)

name: install_agents_md
description:
Generate and write .code_my_spec/AGENTS.md for the project.

Detects the app name from mix.exs and writes a project-specific agent guide.

name: install_claude_md
description:
Create or update the managed section in CLAUDE.md at the project root.

Preserves existing content — only the managed section (between HTML comment
markers) is created or updated. Idempotent.

name: install_credo_checks
description:
Install Credo custom checks into the project.

Creates `.code_my_spec/credo_checks/{framework,local}/` and copies the
framework checks shipped in the harness's `priv/credo_checks/` into
the project's `framework/` directory. The `local/` directory is left
empty for project-specific checks.

name: install_rules
description:
Copy default rule files into the project's .code_my_spec/rules/ directory.

Only copies files that don't already exist, preserving user customizations.

name: list_projects
description:
List available CodeMySpec projects.

Returns the projects accessible to the authenticated user. Use the
project_id from the results to call `init_project` and link your
working directory.
